doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: What he learned from Lester Young: space and restraint
summary: Fuller says Lester taught him how to perform and when not to play; Monk told him 'space' too.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: What did you get from Pres (Lester Young) in that regard, in your time with him?

How to be a performer, how to play, what to play, when to play it, when not to play, when not to use unnecessary phrases that are un-anointed, and I’m guilty of it now sometimes. I do it just to fill a void, sometimes. When Monk was telling me, “Space.” Sometimes, I feel like Dizzy, like I got to cover everything. (Imitates Dizzy’s busy and dense melodic line) I got one I can refer you to, to show
